prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout to clearly highlight pet setup options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Upload Photos Full Bleed Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen using a full bleed layout for visual clarity during pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "full_bleed"}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In Before Waiting Screen: Reorder sign-in to take place right after adoption certificate and before pet generation loading begins.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Explorer Intro Screen: Add an overview screen prior to path selection outlining the companion creation process.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_intro": {"headline": "Explore Companion Paths", "body": "Select whether you prefer a quick pre-made desktop pet or a custom generated companion.", "button_label": "Continue"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Audio Visual Feedback: Add an initialization badge and audio cue component to the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Initializing Desktop Companion...", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:ready_chime", "style": "calm"}]}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Companion Sync Hint: Add a prominent hint explaining that signing in restores previously adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your registered email to restore and sync your desktop pets."}}
6: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Persona Selection Hint: Display a hint on the pick friend step clarifying companion personality traits and desktop behavior.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Each companion exhibits distinct traits and desktop behaviors once activated."}}
7: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Tray Navigation Hint: Include a explicit hint on the final home intro screen explaining system tray controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Right-click your companion in the system tray anytime to control or hide it."}}
8: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Toast Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications with an inline status badge during long loading phases.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Desktop alert will signal when ready", "style": "subtle"}]}}
9: [finish, copy] Home Intro Controls Summary Headline: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain basic desktop controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready for Your Desktop!", "body": "Use system tray shortcuts to interact, change settings, or hide your pet whenever needed."}}
